quotation_policy: Only qualitative intent/context fragments; no historical nominal dimensions/counts/numeric outcomes copied. Metadata line/byte/revision identifiers retain custody.
source_scope: Proposed printed article and nominal drawing/census geometry do not supply an actually made complete article or documented dimensional inspection.
yield_policy: Source-defined numerator/denominator and inclusion/exclusion only if actually supplied; none is supplied by the assigned qualitative question, so definition and records remain missing. No eligibility or defect rule selected.
missing_policy: Actual configuration/revision/lot/process/drawing/dimensions/defects/yield/tolerance/metrology/calibration/uncertainty/custody/applicability/owner/criteria/adoption null/UNKNOWN or UNASSIGNED. No procedure, tool/material/design/process choice, threshold, defect invention, calculation, private source/outcome or duplicate science/installation row.
